question: Who among the following launched the national portal for credit linked government schemes – Jan Samarth Portal in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is Narendra Modi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jan Samarth Portal** is a national portal l**aunched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in June 2022** to **provide information about various credit-linked government schemes** to the citizens of India.
 
• The portal aims to simplify the process of availing of government schemes and benefits by providing all the necessary information in one place.
 
• The portal also **provides information about the eligibility criteria, application process, and documents required for each scheme.**
 
• It is a **part **of the government's **Digital India initiative** and is expected to benefit millions of citizens across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Since May 2014, Narendra Damodardas Modi has held the position of India's 14th prime minister.

 
 
• Modi serves as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Varanasi and served as Gujarat's chief minister from 2001 until 2014.
 
• He belongs to the right-wing Hindu nationalist paramilitary volunteer organization Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) as well as the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He is the prime minister from outside the Indian National Congress with the longest tenure.
 
 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** is the **current Finance Minister and Minister of Corporate Affairs** of the Government of India since 2019.
 
 
• She has been a **member of the Rajya Sabha since 2014** and served as the 28th **Defence Minister from 2017 to 2019.**
 
• She was featured in the **Forbes 2022 list of the world's 100 most powerful women** and was **ranked 36.**
 
 
 
• Smriti Zubin Irani is **currently**** **the Minister of Woman and Child Development and Minister of Minority Affairs.

 
• She was former Minister of Textiles in the Government of India and held the position from May 2017 to July 2021.
 
• Prior to this, she was the Minister of Human Resource Development.

 
• Piyush Goyal is the current **Minister of Textiles and Commerce and Industry** in the Government of India.

 
 
• He was **appointed** as the** **Minister of Textiles** in July 2021**, replacing Smriti Zubin Irani.
 
• **Prior **to this, he held the position of **Minister of Railways and Coal.**
